name: Scaleway Cloud
description: Manage Scaleway cloud infrastructure - virtual instances, Dedibox dedicated servers, Apple silicon Mac minis, volumes, IPs, security groups, images, snapshots, and SSH keys

credential_fields.name: access_key
credential_fields.label: Access Key
credential_fields.description: Scaleway Access Key paired with the Secret Key. Used to load the API key's default Project automatically.

credential_fields.name: token
credential_fields.label: Secret Key
credential_fields.description: Scaleway Secret Key paired with the Access Key

credential_fields.name: project_id
credential_fields.label: Default Project ID
credential_fields.description: Optional Scaleway Project ID used for provisioning. Recommended when the account has more than one project.

tools.name: api_key_get
tools.description: Get the current Scaleway API key metadata, including its default project

tools.name: server_list
tools.description: List all Scaleway servers/instances in a zone. Returns server details including ID, name, state, IP addresses, and type.

zone.description: Scaleway zone (fr-par-1, fr-par-2, nl-ams-1, pl-waw-1, etc.)

tools.name: server_get
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Scaleway server/instance by ID

tools.name: server_create
tools.description: Create a new Scaleway server/instance. Requires commercial_type (e.g., DEV1-S, GP1-S) and image ID.

commercial_type.description: Instance type (DEV1-S, DEV1-M, DEV1-L, GP1-S, GP1-M, etc.)

image.description: Image UUID to use for the server

volumes.description: Optional boot/data volume map keyed by device slot. For an image-derived root volume at slot 0, send only size and volume_type; do not send name or boot. Omit volumes to use the marketplace image default volume.

tools.name: server_delete
tools.description: Delete/terminate a Scaleway server/instance

tools.name: server_action
tools.description: Perform an action on a Scaleway server (poweron, poweroff, reboot, terminate, stop_in_place, backup)

tools.name: volume_list
tools.description: List modern Scaleway Block Storage volumes (SBS 5K/15K) in a zone

tools.name: volume_get
tools.description: Get details of a Scaleway Block Storage (SBS) volume by ID

tools.name: instance_volume_get
tools.description: Get details of a local Instance volume such as l_ssd by ID. Use volume_get for SBS Block Storage volumes.

tools.name: instance_volume_delete
tools.description: Delete a local Instance volume such as l_ssd by ID. The volume must no longer be attached to a server. Use volume_delete for SBS Block Storage volumes.

tools.name: volume_create
tools.description: Create a modern Scaleway Block Storage volume. For an empty volume pass from_empty.size in bytes and perf_iops 5000 or 15000.

tools.name: volume_update
tools.description: Update a Scaleway Block Storage volume, including increasing its size

size.description: New size in bytes; shrinking is not supported

tools.name: volume_delete
tools.description: Delete a Scaleway block storage volume

tools.name: server_volume_attach
tools.description: Attach a Block Storage volume to a Scaleway Instance server

tools.name: server_volume_detach
tools.description: Detach a volume from a Scaleway Instance server without deleting it

tools.name: ip_list
tools.description: List all flexible/reserved IPs in a Scaleway zone

tools.name: ip_get
tools.description: Get details of a specific Scaleway flexible IP

tools.name: ip_create
tools.description: Reserve a new flexible IP address in Scaleway

server_id.description: Optionally attach to a server immediately

tools.name: ip_attach
tools.description: Attach a flexible IP to a Scaleway server

server_id.description: Server UUID to attach the IP to

tools.name: ip_detach
tools.description: Detach a flexible IP from its current server

tools.name: ip_delete
tools.description: Release/delete a flexible IP address

tools.name: security_group_list
tools.description: List all security groups in a Scaleway zone

project_default.description: Only return the default security group for each project

tools.name: security_group_get
tools.description: Get details of a specific Scaleway security group

tools.name: security_group_create
tools.description: Create a new security group in Scaleway

stateful.description: Whether the security group is stateful

tools.name: security_group_delete
tools.description: Delete a Scaleway security group

tools.name: security_group_rules_list
tools.description: List all rules in a Scaleway security group

tools.name: security_group_rule_create
tools.description: Create a new rule in a Scaleway security group

position.description: Position of the rule (lower = higher priority)

tools.name: security_group_rule_delete
tools.description: Delete a rule from a Scaleway security group

tools.name: image_list
tools.description: List available Scaleway images for creating servers

tools.name: image_get
tools.description: Get details of a specific Scaleway image

tools.name: snapshot_list
tools.description: List all snapshots in a Scaleway zone

tools.name: snapshot_get
tools.description: Get details of a specific Scaleway snapshot

tools.name: snapshot_create
tools.description: Create a snapshot of a Scaleway volume

tools.name: snapshot_delete
tools.description: Delete a Scaleway snapshot

tools.name: project_list
tools.description: List Scaleway projects available to this API key

tools.name: server_types_list
tools.description: List server products available in a Scaleway zone

tools.name: server_set_cloud_init
tools.description: Set cloud-init user data before starting a Scaleway server

tools.name: elastic_metal_offers_list
tools.description: List Scaleway Elastic Metal on-demand dedicated-server offers and current stock in a zone

tools.name: elastic_metal_os_list
tools.description: List operating systems available for Scaleway Elastic Metal in a zone

tools.name: elastic_metal_servers_list
tools.description: List Scaleway Elastic Metal servers in a zone

tools.name: elastic_metal_server_get
tools.description: Get a Scaleway Elastic Metal server

tools.name: elastic_metal_server_create
tools.description: Create and optionally install a Scaleway Elastic Metal dedicated server

install.description: OS installation including os_id, hostname, ssh_key_ids, user, and optional partitioning_schema

user_data.description: BytesValue wrapper with a value field containing cloud-init

tools.name: elastic_metal_server_delete
tools.description: Delete a Scaleway Elastic Metal server

tools.name: elastic_metal_server_action
tools.description: Start, stop, or reboot a Scaleway Elastic Metal server

tools.name: elastic_metal_partitioning_default_get
tools.description: Get Scaleway's default partitioning schema for an Elastic Metal offer and OS

tools.name: elastic_metal_partitioning_validate
tools.description: Validate an Elastic Metal partitioning and RAID schema before installation

tools.name: elastic_metal_flexible_ips_list
tools.description: List Flexible IPs associated with Elastic Metal in a zone

tools.name: elastic_metal_flexible_ip_delete
tools.description: Release a Scaleway Elastic Metal Flexible IP

tools.name: apple_products_list
tools.description: List live Scaleway Apple silicon products, locations, lifecycle status, hardware, and prices from the public product catalog

tools.name: apple_server_types_list
tools.description: List Apple silicon Mac mini server types and current stock in a zone

tools.name: apple_os_list
tools.description: List operating-system images available for Apple silicon Mac minis in a zone

tools.name: apple_servers_list
tools.description: List Apple silicon Mac mini servers in a zone

tools.name: apple_server_get
tools.description: Get an Apple silicon Mac mini server by ID

tools.name: apple_server_create
tools.description: Provision a dedicated Apple silicon Mac mini. macOS servers have a mandatory 24-hour minimum allocation.

type.description: Apple silicon server type, for example M4-S

tools.name: apple_server_update
tools.description: Update an Apple silicon Mac mini name, deletion schedule, VPC support, commitment, or public bandwidth

tools.name: apple_server_delete
tools.description: Delete an Apple silicon Mac mini after its minimum allocation period

tools.name: apple_server_reboot
tools.description: Reboot an Apple silicon Mac mini through the control plane

tools.name: apple_server_reinstall
tools.description: Reinstall an Apple silicon Mac mini. This permanently erases all data on its disk.

tools.name: dedibox_offers_list
tools.description: List currently orderable Scaleway Dedibox physical-server offers in a zone

tools.name: dedibox_server_create
tools.description: Order a Scaleway Dedibox physical server. Returns a service ID while the hardware is being delivered.

tools.name: dedibox_service_get
tools.description: Get a Dedibox order/service and its physical server resource ID once delivered

tools.name: dedibox_service_delete
tools.description: Terminate a Dedibox order or subscription by service ID

tools.name: dedibox_server_get
tools.description: Get a delivered Dedibox physical server, including status and public IP addresses

tools.name: dedibox_server_delete
tools.description: Delete and terminate a delivered Dedibox physical server

tools.name: dedibox_os_list
tools.description: List operating systems compatible with a delivered Dedibox server

tools.name: dedibox_server_install
tools.description: Install an operating system on a delivered Dedibox physical server

tools.name: dedibox_install_get
tools.description: Get the current Dedibox operating-system installation status

tools.name: dedibox_server_reboot
tools.description: Reboot a delivered Dedibox physical server

tools.name: ssh_keys_list
tools.description: List IAM SSH keys, optionally scoped to one Scaleway project

tools.name: ssh_key_create
tools.description: Create a project-scoped IAM SSH key

tools.name: ssh_key_delete
tools.description: Delete one IAM SSH key by its exact ID

tools.name: project_get
tools.description: Get a Scaleway project, including its Organization ID

tools.name: iam_security_settings_get
tools.description: Get Organization security settings, including the maximum allowed API-key lifetime

tools.name: iam_application_create
tools.description: Create a Scaleway IAM application for machine credentials

tools.name: iam_application_delete
tools.description: Delete a Scaleway IAM application

tools.name: iam_policy_create
tools.description: Create a Scaleway IAM policy with project- or Organization-scoped rules

tools.name: iam_policy_delete
tools.description: Delete a Scaleway IAM policy

tools.name: iam_api_key_create
tools.description: Create an API key. The secret_key is returned only by this call.

tools.name: iam_api_key_delete
tools.description: Revoke a Scaleway API key

tools.name: object_bucket_list
tools.description: List Scaleway Object Storage buckets visible to the core Scaleway connection in a region

tools.name: object_bucket_head
tools.description: Verify that a Scaleway Object Storage bucket exists without listing or modifying its contents

tools.name: object_bucket_create
tools.description: Create an empty Scaleway Object Storage bucket using the core Scaleway connection credentials

tools.name: object_bucket_delete
tools.description: Delete an empty Scaleway Object Storage bucket using the core Scaleway connection credentials
